title: VLAN plan
content:
# VLAN plan

VLAN numbers are the same at every site. Subnets below are for HQ; branches use the same VLAN numbers with their own ranges.

| VLAN | Name | Purpose | HQ subnet |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 10 | DATA | Wired users | 10.11.10.0/24 |
| 20 | VOICE | IP phones | 10.11.20.0/24 |
| 30 | WIFI-CORP | Corporate wireless | 10.11.30.0/23 |
| 40 | WIFI-GUEST | Guest wireless, internet only | 172.16.40.0/22 |
| 50 | PRINTERS | Printers and scanners | 10.11.50.0/24 |
| 99 | MGMT | Switch and access point management | 10.10.0.0/16 |
| 998 | NATIVE | Native VLAN on trunks; carries no traffic | none |
| 999 | PARKING | Unused ports; never routed | none |

## Rules

- Never use VLAN 1 for anything.
- Guest traffic (VLAN 40) is only allowed to the internet firewall.
- Trunks only carry the VLANs the far end needs; see [[Access and trunk ports]].
